newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway govt sees 1997 CPI at 2.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Norway govt sees 1997 CPI at 2.5 pct.

text.p: The Norwegian government, in its 1997 draft budget, forecast the consumer price index in 1997 up 2.5 percent.
At the same time the government left unchanged its forecast for inflation in 1996 at 1.25 percent.
It attributed higher growth in 1997 to higher than expected wage increases this year.
Unemployment was seen falling slightly to 4.25 percent of the labour force this year from 4.3 percent in the forecast in May. The forecast for 1997 came to 4.0 percent.
